paite: Paul, Pathian deihdan a Khrist Jesu a om hinna thuchiam dungzui a, Khrist Jesu sawltak in,
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

paite: ka tapa deihtak Timothi kiang ah, Pa Pathian leh Khrist Jesu i Toupa kiang a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna om hen.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Sun leh zan khawl lou a ka thumnate a nang hon theigige in, ka pipute a kipan a sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei a ama nna ka sep gigena pa, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen a,
heading: Kipahthu Genna
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

paite: kipak a ka dimtheihna ding in hon muh ka ut mahmah hi, na khitui theigige in.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

paite: Ginna taktak nangmah a om ka theigige a, huai ginna atung in na pi Lois ah a-om a, huan na nu Iunis ah, tu in nangmah ah leng a om chih diktak in ka theichian hi.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

paite: Huaiziak in ka khut ngak ziak a Pathian thilthawnpiak nangmah a om pen mutkuang ding in ka hon theisak hi.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

paite: Pathian in launa kha ahon pe kei a, thilhihtheihna leh itna leh kithuzohna kha ahon pe zaw hi.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

paite: Huchi in i Toupa thu theihsak zumpih ke'nla, kei ahentapa leng hon zumpih sam ke'n. Tanchinhoih ziak a gimthuak Pathian thilhihtheihna dungzui in hon thuakpih zaw in.
heading: Hangsan Ding A Thuhilhna
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

paite: Ama'n i thilhihte bang hilou in, ama seh leh hehpihna bang zaw in hon hondam a, sapna siangthou in ahon sam hi; huai hehpihna leilung pian ma a Khrist Jesu a hon piak ahita hi.
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

paite: Himahleh i Hondampa Khrist Jesu kilakna ziak in tu in hihlat in a-omta hi. Ama'n sihna hihmang in, tanchinhoih in hinna leh sih theihlouhna ahihlangta hi.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

paite: Huai tanchinhoih theisak ding a tangkoupihpa, sawltak leh sinsaktu a seh ka hi.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

paite: Hiai ziak in ahi, hiai thilte leng ka na thuak. Himahleh ka zum kei; ka ginpa ka thei a, akiang a ka kepsak huai ni a ding in akemhoih thei chih diktak in ka thei hi.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

paite: Khrist Jesu a om ginna leh itna nei in, ka kam a thudik na zakte zui tinten in.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: I sung a teng Kha Siangthou hon kepsak thutak kemhoih in.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

paite: Asia gam a om tengtengte'n ahon nungngatsan uh chih na thei a; alak uah Phigelas leh Harmogenes apang uhi.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

paite: Toupa'n Onesiforas inkuanpihte kiang ah zahngaihna pia hen aw, ama'n ahon hihhalh zelzel ziak in; leh ka khainiang but leng ahon zumpih kei hi.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

paite: Rome ahong tun in hon limzon ngial a, ahong mukhia hi.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

paite: Huai ni chiang in Toupa kiang a zahngaihna mu ding in Toupa'n amah sep hen. Ephesa a anasep thupidan na thei hi.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
